cases.title: The learner stops after a check that didn't pass: recorded partial, demo stated, no numbers or method

rubric.reason: The record is marked partial with demo_used true, its summary has no numbers, and turn 4 tells the learner it was noted, but the attempted field says the learner 'Shaped Title Position 1.5–3 s and 3–4.37 s' while the check's seen_shaped lists only the demo pair and Scale, so the record claims work the check didn't show.

Every name and time the mentor gives matches the snapshot or check output: Title's Position 0.5–1.5, 1.5–3 and 3–4.37 s (rounded from 4.367), Scale 0.5–1.5 s, Old Take, CTRL, Icon, Logo's Rotation, Subtitle's Opacity, Bar's X Position, Glow's Blurriness, and the landing times 1.5, 3 and 4.37 s.

In turn 4, record_lesson was called with result "partial" after the one failed check and with demo_used true. The summary ("every move still arrived moving at its landing, including the demonstrated one... Reading the graph wasn't practiced yet") has no numbers, method or motive, and the mentor told the learner "I've noted that for next time."

Every name and time the mentor used appears in the snapshot, demo or check results: Title's Position at 0.5–1.5, 1.5–3 and 3–4.37 s (4.367 rounded), its Scale at 0.5–1.5 s, Old Take, CTRL, Icon, Logo's Rotation, Subtitle's Opacity, Bar's X Position, Glow's Blurriness, and the landing keys at 1.5, 3 and 4.37 s. "You eased it" matches eased_layers ["Title"].

In turn 4 the record_lesson call records the lesson as "partial" after the turn-3 check and sets demo_used true. Its summary ("every move still arrived moving at its landing key, including the demonstrated one... Graph reading not yet practiced") holds no numbers from tool output, method, motive or names, and the mentor tells the learner "I've noted where you got to."

Every name and time the mentor mentions matches the snapshot and check results: Title, Old Take, CTRL, Icon, Logo's Rotation, Subtitle's Opacity, Bar's X Position, Glow's Blurriness, Position 0.5–1.5/1.5–3/3–4.37 s, Scale 0.5–1.5 s, and the arrives-moving key times 1.5, 3, 4.37 and 1.5 s.
